verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Jupyter access via instance portal (Cloudflare tunnel) and SSH key-based connection (docs-48, docs-49, docs-43/36) which supports IDE remote-SSH connection, but there's no explicit one-click VS Code/Cursor integration or documented single-step workflow tying template launch directly to IDE attach — connecting requires manual SSH key setup and port/tunnel configuration rather than a single unified step. missing for 10: explicit VS Code/Cursor one-click connect docs, independent hands-on confirmation of IDE attach experience, evidence of a single unified action instead of separate SSH+Jupyter setup steps.
